actions[].area.note: Cone, line, sphere or cylinder in feet, read from the action prose by normalize-monsters.ts.

actions[].attack_kind.note: melee, ranged or melee_or_ranged, read from the attack header by normalize-monsters.ts.

actions[].damage[].condition.on_failed_r.note: Second stage of a two-stage condition (petrification), merged in from monster-engine-annotations.json.

actions[].pull_distance_ft.note: Distance in feet the action pulls each target toward the monster, merged in from monster-engine-annotations.json.

actions[].options.from.options[].area.note: Area of one breath weapon in feet, read from the action prose by normalize-monsters.ts.

actions[].range.note: Normal and long range in feet, read from the attack header by normalize-monsters.ts.

actions[].reach_ft.note: Reach in feet, read from the attack header by normalize-monsters.ts.

special_abilities[].damage[].grapple.note: Grapple escape DC, merged in from monster-engine-annotations.json.

multi_classing.proficiency_choices[].id.note: Stable id of a proficiency choice of the multi-classing rules, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.

proficiency_choices[].from.options[].cho.note: Stable id of a choice nested in the options of a proficiency choice, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.

proficiency_choices[].id.note: Stable id of a proficiency choice, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.

spellcasting.caster_kind.note: full, half or pact, from the level at which the class gets spell slots and the Pact Magic feature, set by derive-class-spellcasting.ts.

spellcasting.prepared_formula.note: How many spells a prepared caster prepares, read from the Preparing and Casting Spells text by derive-class-spellcasting.ts.

spellcasting.prepared_formula.class_leve.note: Whether the class level counts in full or as half rounded down.

spellcasting.prepared_formula.minimum.note: The least number of prepared spells, read from the text.

spellcasting.spellbook_size.note: The spells in the wizard's spellbook, set by derive-class-spellcasting.ts.

spellcasting.spellbook_size.initial.note: The spells in the spellbook at 1st level, read from the Spellbook text.

spellcasting.spellbook_size.per_level.note: The spells added to the spellbook for each level gained after the first. The SRD Spellbook rules state it; the wizard text of this data does not.

spellcasting.subclass_spells.note: How the subclasses of the class add spells, set by derive-class-spellcasting.ts from the subclass spell lists and the subclass spells features.

spellcasting.subclass_spells.with_spells.note: Indices of the subclasses that have a spell list in 5e-SRD-Subclasses.

spellcasting.subclass_spells.without_spe.note: Indices of the subclasses of the class that have no spell list.

starting_equipment_options[].from.option.note: Stable id of a choice nested in the options of a starting-equipment choice, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.
Stable id of a choice nested in a combined option of a starting-equipment choice, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.

starting_equipment_options[].id.note: Stable id of a starting-equipment choice, set by derive-class-choices.ts and never renamed.

adds.note: Conditions applied along with this one, from the text of the condition.

effects.note: Mechanical effects of the condition as data (roll modifiers, speed, restrictions, damage, bonuses), restating its text.

exhaustion_level.note: Level of a numbered exhaustion condition, with the conditions of the level above and below.

immune_if_feature.note: Features whose text makes their owner immune to the condition.

immune_if_feature[].feature.note: Index of a feature whose text makes its owner immune to the condition.

immune_if_feature[].while_condition.note: Condition the owner must also hold for the immunity, from the text of the feature.

on_remove.note: What happens when the condition ends, from the text of the rage and Frenzy features.

removes.note: Conditions this one ends when it is applied, from the SRD concentration rules and the text of the rage and Sacred Weapon features.

exhaustion-1.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

exhaustion-2.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

exhaustion-3.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

exhaustion-4.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

exhaustion-5.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

exhaustion-6.note: One record per exhaustion level, split from the SRD Exhaustion condition.

enraged.note: Barbarian Rage recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD class feature.

frenzied.note: Berserker Frenzy recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD subclass feature.

reckless.note: Reckless Attack recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD class feature.

dodging.note: The Dodge action recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD combat rules.

infested.note: Condition for monster damage over time (e.g. parasite attachment).

swallowed.note: Condition for being swallowed by a larger creature.

weakened.note: Debuff condition for monster and magic-item effects.

slowed.note: Debuff condition for monster and magic-item effects.

disengaged.note: The Disengage action recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD combat rules.

surprised.note: The surprise rule recast as a condition; text adapted from the SRD combat rules.

no-reactions.note: Condition for effects that stop a creature from taking reactions; original wording.

concentrating.note: The SRD concentration rules recast as a condition; original wording.

blessed.note: Effect of the bless spell recast as a condition; original wording.

shield-of-faith.note: Effect of the shield of faith spell recast as a condition; original wording.

sanctuary.note: Effect of the sanctuary spell recast as a condition; original wording.

beacon-of-hope.note: Effect of the beacon of hope spell recast as a condition; original wording.

spiritual-weapon.note: Effect of the spiritual weapon spell recast as a condition; original wording.

spirit-guardians.note: Effect of the spirit guardians spell recast as a condition; original wording.

sacred-weapon.note: The Sacred Weapon Channel Divinity option recast as a condition; original wording.

magic-weapon.note: Effect of the magic weapon spell recast as a condition; original wording.

divine-favor.note: Effect of the divine favor spell recast as a condition; original wording.

branding-smite.note: Effect of the branding smite spell recast as a condition; original wording.

mage-armor.note: Effect of the mage armor spell recast as a condition; original wording.

commanded.note: Effect of the command spell recast as a condition; original wording.

ammunition.note: Links a ranged weapon to the equipment index of its ammunition.

effect.note: Damage applied when a consumable (e.g. Acid Vial) is used.

is_consumable.note: Marks an item as expended on use.

material.note: Item material (e.g. metal) for rules that depend on the material.

stackable.note: Marks ammunition and consumables as stackable.

feature_specific.damage_type.note: Index into 5e-SRD-Damage-Types of the damage type of a dragon ancestor, read from the name of the feature by derive-feature-engine.ts.

feature_specific.engine.note: Mechanics of a class feature of levels 1 to 5, and of levels 6 to 20 of every class (action cost, recharge, uses, modifiers), written by hand in feature-engine-annotations.json and merged in by derive-feature-engine.ts.

feature_specific.granted_languages.note: Languages the feature gives, from its text, written in feature-engine-annotations.json and merged in by derive-feature-engine.ts.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].cho.note: Number of languages of the owner's choice that the feature gives.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].fro.note: What the chosen languages are taken from: the languages the favored enemies speak.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].ind.note: The index of a language the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Languages.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].nam.note: The name of a language the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Languages.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].sec.note: A secret language of a class with no record in 5e-SRD-Languages: druidic or thieves-cant.

feature_specific.granted_languages[].url.note: The url of a language the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Languages.

feature_specific.granted_proficiencies.note: Proficiencies the feature gives, from its text, written in feature-engine-annotations.json and merged in by derive-feature-engine.ts.

feature_specific.granted_proficiencies[].note: Number of skill proficiencies of the owner's choice that the feature gives.
What the chosen proficiencies are taken from: skills.
The index of a proficiency the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Proficiencies.
The name of a proficiency the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Proficiencies.
The url of a proficiency the feature gives, a reference into 5e-SRD-Proficiencies.

feature_specific.grants_asi.note: Set on every Ability Score Improvement feature by derive-feature-engine.ts.

feature_specific.heal.note: Hit points the feature restores (dice, bonus, class level), from its text, written in feature-engine-annotations.json and merged in by derive-feature-engine.ts.

cost.note: Item price. Not SRD text; origin unverified.

effect.note: Structured mechanics (ability, resistance, healing, save and skill modifiers, duration) read from the item prose.

enchantment.note: Structured +N armor and weapon bonuses read from the item prose.

is_consumable.note: Marks an item as expended on use.

requires_attunement.note: Attunement as a boolean, read from the item prose.

weight.note: Item weight. Not SRD text; origin unverified.

actions[].attack_type.note: Melee or Ranged, read from the action prose.

actions[].condition.note: Condition applied by the action, read from the action prose.

actions[].damage[].condition.note: Condition applied with the damage, read from the action prose.

actions[].damage[].grapple.note: Grapple escape DC and extra condition, read from the action prose.

actions[].options.from.options[].conditi.note: Condition applied by an action option, read from the action prose.

actions[].preference.note: Preference for when to use the action.

actions[].situation.note: Precondition on the target for using the action.

actions[].supply.note: Ammunition or thrown item and a chosen default count (not a book value).

actions[].weapon.note: Equipment index of the weapon the action uses.

bonus_actions.note: Bonus actions the monster can take, read from its prose.

environments.note: Habitats. Not SRD 5.1 text; origin unverified.

senses.blindsight_blind_beyond.note: Blindsight "blind beyond this radius" as a boolean, read from the senses prose.

senses.blindsight_deafened.note: Grimlock blindsight range while deafened, read from the senses prose.

special_abilities[].bonus_action.note: Bonus action granted by the ability, read from its prose.

special_abilities[].damage[].condition.note: Condition applied by the ability, read from its prose.

special_abilities[].damage[].dc.note: Saving throw for the ability, read from its prose.

special_abilities[].relentless_max_damag.note: Relentless damage threshold, read from the ability prose.

casting_time_data.note: casting_time as an amount of a unit, derived from the casting_time text by derive-spell-mechanics.ts.

damage[].damage_at_slot_level_data.note: damage_at_slot_level as dice, a flat bonus and whether the spellcasting ability modifier is added, derived from the damage_at_slot_level strings by derive-spell-combat.ts.

duration_data.note: duration as a unit and a length, derived from the duration text by derive-spell-mechanics.ts.

engine.note: Classification of a combat spell (kind, target, campaign, npc), written by hand in spell-engine-annotations.json and merged in by derive-spell-engine.ts.

heal_at_slot_level_data.note: heal_at_slot_level as dice, a flat bonus and whether the spellcasting ability modifier is added, derived from the heal_at_slot_level strings by derive-spell-combat.ts.

range_ft.note: range as a number of feet, or a word for self, touch, sight, special or unlimited, derived from the range text by derive-spell-mechanics.ts.

targets_at_slot_level.note: Number of targets, darts, rays or bolts at each slot level, derived from the higher_level text and the number the description states by derive-spell-combat.ts.

temp_hp_at_slot_level.note: Temporary hit points at each slot level as dice and a flat bonus, derived from the description and higher_level text by derive-spell-combat.ts.
